WITH RECURSIVE MENU_TREE_NODE AS ( SELECT M.MENU_ID , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_TYPE , M.URL , M.PARENT_MENU_ID , M.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU M WHERE M.MENU_PERMISSION_CODE IN
#{permissionCode}
AND M.DATA_STATUS = 'ENABLED'
UNION
SELECT P.MENU_ID , P.MENU_NAME , P.MENU_TYPE , P.URL , P.PARENT_MENU_ID , P.SORT_ORDER FROM TB_MENU P INNER JOIN MENU_TREE_NODE C ON P.MENU_ID = C.PARENT_MENU_ID WHERE P.DATA_STATUS = 'ENABLED' ) SELECT DISTINCT MENU_ID , MENU_NAME , MENU_TYPE , URL , PARENT_MENU_ID , SORT_ORDER FROM MENU_TREE_NODE ORDER BY SORT_ORDER
